'''Silas Gerenz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he owned a small shop where he bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
